infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: InciFact uses your camera to scan cosmetic (INCI) and food ingredient labels directly on your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: InciFact lets you select photos of product ingredient labels from your library to analyze them.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow InciFact to scan ingredient labels on cosmetic and food packages.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow InciFact to read ingredient label photos from your gallery.
